title: 情态动词的推测用法（must/may/might/can't，语气强弱）
knowledgePoint: 情态动词表推测的核心用法（must/may/might/can't/could的语气层级）、不同时态语境适配（现在/过去/正在进行的推测）、否定式与疑问式表达、易混淆情态动词辨析（如may not vs can't）

questions.question: The lights in the office are still on—she ______ be working late again. She ______ have forgotten to turn them off, but that’s unlikely because she’s very careful.
questions.explanation: 第一空“灯还亮着”是明确依据，表“极有可能在加班”，用must（语气最强）；第二空“可能忘关灯”是较弱推测，用may，符合“强依据强推测，弱依据弱推测”的规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 情态动词推测语气强度排序：must（一定）> may（可能）> might/could（或许）> can't（不可能，否定最强）。

questions.question: He hasn’t replied to the email yet—he may not have seen it, or he could be busy with the meeting. It can't be that he is ignoring you.
questions.explanation: “may not have seen”表“可能没看到”（对过去的弱否定推测）；“could be busy”表“可能正在忙”（对现在的弱推测）；“can't be”表“不可能在忽视”（对现在的强否定推测），符合不同推测场景的语气适配，逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 对过去的推测结构：情态动词+have+过去分词；对现在/正在进行的推测：情态动词+be+doing/形容词/名词。

questions.question: The ancient ruins ______ date back to the Han Dynasty—archaeologists ______ found pottery and coins from that period. They ______ be from a later era, as the style is very distinct.
questions.explanation: 第一空“有汉代陶器和钱币”是强依据，表“一定追溯到汉代”，用must；第二空“已发现文物”用have found（现在完成时）；第三空“风格独特”表“不可能来自后世”，用can't，符合推测逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: must表推测仅用于肯定句，否定推测用can't，不用mustn't（mustn't表“禁止”）。

questions.question: She must be waiting for us at the station—we agreed to meet there at 3 p.m. She can't have missed the train, as she left home an hour earlier.
questions.explanation: “约定3点见面”表“一定在等我们”（对现在的强推测）；“提前一小时出发”表“不可能错过火车”（对过去的强否定推测），结构和语气均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 对正在进行的推测：情态动词+be+doing（如must be waiting一定在等）；对过去动作的推测：情态动词+have+done（如can't have missed不可能错过）。

questions.question: — Who sent this anonymous gift? — It ______ be Mary—she knows my favorite brand. It ______ be Tom, though, as he mentioned he wanted to surprise me recently.
questions.explanation: 第一空“知道我喜欢的品牌”是强依据，表“极可能是玛丽”，用must；第二空“提到想给我惊喜”是弱依据，表“或许是汤姆”，用might，符合语气层级。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 同一语境中可根据依据强弱，搭配不同语气的情态动词，体现推测的不确定性差异。

questions.question: The project may not be completed on time—there have been several unexpected delays. However, the team could have overcome the difficulties if they had received more support.
questions.explanation: 第一空“有意外延误”表“可能无法按时完成”（对现在的弱否定推测）；第二空“如果得到更多支持或许能克服困难”是虚拟语气，could have done表“本可以”，虽非推测但语法正确，整体逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: may not表“可能不”（弱否定推测），can't表“不可能”（强否定推测），两者语气差异显著。

questions.question: The witness’s description ______ be accurate—she ______ been under great stress during the interrogation. Her memory ______ have been affected by emotions, leading to inconsistencies.
questions.explanation: 第一空“证词有矛盾”表“可能不准确”（弱否定推测），用may not；第二空“审讯期间压力大”用has been（现在完成时）；第三空“记忆可能受情绪影响”（弱推测），用might，符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 推测时需结合语境判断依据强弱，避免强语气情态动词（must/can't）用于弱依据场景。

questions.question: He can't be in the office now—his car isn’t in the parking lot. He must have gone to the client’s company for a meeting, as he mentioned it yesterday.
questions.explanation: “车不在停车场”表“不可能在办公室”（强否定推测）；“昨天提到要去客户公司”表“一定去开会了”（对过去的强推测），结构和逻辑均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 对现在状态的否定推测：can't+be+地点/形容词（如can't be in the office不可能在办公室）。

questions.question: The experimental results ______ be flawed—they ______ not match the theoretical predictions at all. The researchers ______ have made a mistake in data collection.
questions.explanation: 第一空“完全不符合理论预测”是强依据，表“结果一定有缺陷”，用must；第二空“不匹配”用do not（一般现在时，主语为复数）；第三空“可能在数据收集时出错”（弱推测），用might，符合推测逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 情态动词表推测时，其后的动词形式需根据推测对象的时态调整（现在用原形，过去用have+过去分词）。

questions.question: She might have missed the bus—she is usually on time, but today she hasn’t arrived yet. It mustn’t be that she forgot about the appointment, as I reminded her this morning.
questions.explanation: “mustn’t be”用法错误，表“不可能”的强否定推测需用can't be，mustn't表“禁止”，不能用于推测，题干混淆了情态动词的功能。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 情态动词表推测的否定形式：must→can't；may→may not；might→might not/could not，需严格区分功能。

questions.question: — Could this painting be a masterpiece by Van Gogh? — It ______ be— the brushstrokes and color palette are very similar. But it ______ be a copy, as there’s no signature on it.
questions.explanation: 第一空“笔触和色调相似”是中等依据，表“可能是梵高的杰作”，用may；第二空“无签名”表“或许是仿品”，用might，均为弱-中等推测，符合“无明确证据”的语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: could表推测时语气比may/might更弱，常用于疑问句或不确定场景（如Could it be...? 可能是……吗？）。

questions.question: The temperature has dropped sharply—they must be feeling cold without warm clothes. They might not have checked the weather forecast before going out.
questions.explanation: “气温骤降”表“一定觉得冷”（对现在的强推测）；“没看天气预报”表“可能没看”（对过去的弱否定推测），结构和语气均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 对他人感受/状态的推测：情态动词+be+形容词（如must be feeling cold一定觉得冷）。

questions.question: The company’s profits ______ have increased by 20%—the market report shows strong demand for their products. They ______ have achieved such growth without the new policy, which boosted sales significantly.
questions.explanation: 第一空“市场报告显示需求旺盛”是强依据，表“利润一定增长了20%”，用must；第二空“新政策推动销售”表“没有新政策不可能实现增长”，用can't，符合推测逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 对过去结果的强推测：must have+过去分词；强否定推测：can't have+过去分词。

questions.question: He may be working from home today—his office door was locked when I passed by. He can't have taken a day off, as he has a tight schedule this week.
questions.explanation: “办公室门锁着”表“可能在家工作”（对现在的弱推测）；“日程紧张”表“不可能请假”（对过去的强否定推测），语法和逻辑均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 推测时可结合间接证据（如门锁着、日程表），无需直接观察，体现情态动词的灵活应用。

questions.question: — Why isn’t she answering the phone? — She ______ be in a meeting—she usually doesn’t pick up during meetings. Or she ______ have left her phone at home, though that’s rare.
questions.explanation: 第一空“开会时通常不接电话”是强依据，表“一定在开会”，用must；第二空“很少忘带手机”是弱依据，表“或许忘在家里”，用might，符合语气层级。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 结合日常习惯进行推测时，常用must（强依据）或may/might（弱依据），使推测更贴合实际。

questions.question: The historical document might not have been written by the king himself—it could have been drafted by his ministers. There’s no direct evidence to prove its authorship.
questions.explanation: “无直接证据”表“可能不是国王亲自写的”（弱否定推测）和“可能由大臣起草”（弱推测），might not have done和could have done的用法正确，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 弱否定推测常用might not have done（可能没做），避免用can't have done（不可能没做），除非有强否定依据。

questions.question: The athlete ______ have trained extremely hard—she broke the world record by a large margin. She ______ have succeeded without her coach’s guidance, who helped her optimize her technique.
questions.explanation: 第一空“大幅打破世界纪录”是强依据，表“一定训练得非常刻苦”，用must；第二空“教练帮助优化技术”表“没有教练不可能成功”，用can't，符合推测逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 对过去动作的强推测需基于明确结果（如破纪录、获奖），弱推测基于不确定线索（如可能、或许）。

questions.question: It can't be raining outside—the sun is shining brightly. They mustn’t have brought umbrellas with them, so we don’t need to wait for them to pack.
questions.explanation: “mustn’t have brought”用法错误，表“不可能带了雨伞”的强否定推测需用can't have brought，mustn't表“禁止”，不能用于对过去的推测，题干混淆了情态动词的功能。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 对过去的否定推测只有“情态动词+have+过去分词”结构，mustn't无此用法，需严格区分。

questions.question: The student’s essay ______ be plagiarized—some paragraphs are identical to an online article. He ______ have done it intentionally, though—he might not have realized the consequences of copying.
questions.explanation: 第一空“段落与网络文章完全一致”是强依据，表“论文一定是抄袭的”，用must；第二空“可能没意识到抄袭的后果”表“可能不是故意的”（弱否定推测），用may not，符合逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: may not表“可能不”，用于否定推测时语气较弱，适合“无明确证据证明故意”的场景。

questions.question: She could be on her way to the airport—her flight leaves in two hours. She might have missed the earlier bus, so she’ll probably arrive a bit late for check-in.
questions.explanation: “航班两小时后起飞”表“可能在去机场的路上”（对现在的弱推测）；“可能错过早班车”表“或许会晚点值机”（对过去的弱推测），could和might的用法正确，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: could和might表推测时语气相近，可互换，均用于弱依据场景，体现推测的不确定性。
